bf-19f2be712a48c039f8a3730a.what: Malformed realtime channel params become an internal-server error.
bf-19f2be712a48c039f8a3730a.root_cause: channelContext threw a native TypeError for client schema rejection. The Effect/native stream boundary retained it, and oRPC redacted it as an internal error.
bf-19f2be712a48c039f8a3730a.fixed_by: Throw an explicit ORPCError BAD_REQUEST at the client parameter validation boundary; retain stored-value validation behavior. Same real API reproduction and regression tests now pass.

bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.what: Invalid agent payload is classified BAD_REQUEST but sent as HTTP 500.
bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.root_cause: createRpcRouter supplied a custom errorStatusMap without COMMON_ERROR_STATUS_MAP. oRPC treats that map as a replacement, so unmapped standard errors defaulted to 500.
bf-e40ace89ce2e110b662b61ac.fixed_by: Merge oRPC standard error statuses before configured domain overrides. Same real API reproduction and regression tests now pass.
